as_told.title: Philadelphia Experiment
as_told.place_text: Philadelphia Navy Yard to Norfolk, Virginia

related.note: Both are about the Philadelphia Experiment. This telling says it really happened in Rhode Island and Philadelphia was the cover story, while the story calls the Philadelphia-to-Norfolk teleportation a bogus disinformation campaign.

plain: The Philadelphia Experiment is a rumor from the 1940s that the Navy teleported a ship, with its crew still aboard, from a Navy port in Philadelphia to a port in Norfolk, Virginia. Michels tells it himself in two episodes: in one he calls it "a clearly bogus disinfo campaign" and ties it to the researcher Thomas Townsend Brown, and in the other he simply calls it a rumor, linking it to the men Bill Moore, Carlos Allende (also given as Carl Allen) and Morris Jessup and to a book called The Philadelphia Experiment. Why it matters to him is the question of whether the tale was planted to hide or discredit real research.
